This compact example demonstrates the document route with retained values. It
does not execute a model and does not establish physical-model validity.

## Question

How closely does the retained model profile follow the retained observations
over the measured position range?

## Conditions

The horizontal quantity is position in metres and the response is a
dimensionless concentration fraction. The blue line is the retained model
relationship; orange open circles are retained observations with assigned
uncertainty intervals. The data authority is `data/profile.csv`.

## Result

::: {#fig-profile}

```{=latex}
\centering
\providecommand{\profiledatatable}{data/profile.csv}
\input{figures/profile.tex}
```

::: {.content-visible when-format="html"}
![Retained model profile and observation points with uncertainty intervals.](figures/generated/profile.svg){width=94%}
:::

The shared LaTeX-native figure reads the retained CSV in both output routes.
The line represents the retained continuous relationship and the points are
the retained observations.
:::

## Interpretation and limitation

The example reports the displayed retained comparison consistently in both
formats. The values are a small teaching set with assigned uncertainty; they
support the rendering route only, not code verification, solution verification,
or physical validation.

## Provenance

The retained table is `data/profile.csv`; the figure source is
`figures/profile.tex`; the SVG is generated from the same source with
`dvilualatex` and `dvisvgm`. Rendering uses `../render.sh` with `--no-execute`.
